			remove_ideas = ADISCORD_vorkerland_wkr_doctrine_output_over_men
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ADISCORD_vorkerland_vad_war_economy } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ADISCORD_vorkerland_vad_war_economy }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ADISCORD_vorkerland_vad_doctrine } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ADISCORD_vorkerland_vad_doctrine }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ADISCORD_vorkerland_tva_doctrine } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ADISCORD_vorkerland_tva_doctrine }
			}
			add_ideas = ADISCORD_vorkerland_measurable_republic
			add_stability = 0.03
			add_political_power = 25
			custom_effect_tooltip = WRK_technocratic_republic_settlement_tt
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 16 }
	}

	focus = {
		id = WRK_utilitarian_restore_unity_tower
		icon = GFX_focus_WRK_utilitarian_restore_unity_tower
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY FOCUS_FILTER_STABILITY }
		x = 0
		y = 1
		relative_position_id = WRK_utilitarian_build_measurable_republic
		cost = 4
		prerequisite = { focus = WRK_utilitarian_build_measurable_republic }
		allow_branch = { tag = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_postwar_integration has_country_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_route_utilitarian }
		available = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_phase_postwar_integration }
		cancel_if_invalid = yes
		completion_reward = {
			ADISCORD_reform_cultural_development = yes
			add_stability = 0.01
			add_political_power = 10
			add_command_power = 5
			ADISCORD_vorkerland_restore_unity_tower = yes
			# The route's own postwar tree replaces the settlement graph on the next day.
			custom_effect_tooltip = WRK_technical_directorate_tree_tt
			hidden_effect = { ADISCORD_vorkerland_schedule_route_tree = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 14 }
	}

}
